description: Lists the dated feasts, fasts and holy days in a window: Ash Wednesday, Holy Week, Easter, Ascension, Pentecost, Trinity, Christ the King, Advent, Christmas, the Epiphany, the feasts of our Lord, apostles and evangelists, with each day's color. Applies the 1979 Book of Common Prayer rules that move a feast off a Sunday or out of Holy Week and Easter Week. Optionally includes Orthodox Pascha, Julian-calendar Christmas and Reformation Day.

days.description: Length of the window in days, 1 to 400. Default 60.

from.description: First date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Mountain Time.

include_other_traditions.description: Include Orthodox Pascha, Julian-calendar Christmas and Reformation Day. Default true.

include_saints_days.description: Include apostles', evangelists' and other saints' days. Default true.

name: upcoming_feast_days
title: Upcoming feast days
